verdict.rationale: Heap's session replay page says replays are "automatically cued to the exact event you need" and that client- and server-side events, including errors, can be searched within a replay, which implies event-to-replay navigation. Nothing documents jumping from a funnel drop-off to replays of the users who dropped, and Session Replay is a paid add-on on higher tiers. missing for 10: documented funnel-drop-off-to-replay drill-down, explicit error-event-to-affected-users replay workflow, in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration.
